summary: Master Actuarial Concepts for Non-Actuaries to interpret reserving models, validate pricing, and drive capital planning. Join our 5-day expert-led course today.
lede: Actuarial concepts help insurance professionals outside actuarial roles interpret and validate reserves, pricing, and capital assessments. This course is for managers, analysts, risk officers, product developers, and compliance specialists who work with actuarial teams and use their outputs in business decisions. It covers building and reading loss development triangles, estimating IBNR and IBNER, comparing deterministic and stochastic models, and communicating risk margins to non-technical stakeholders.

prerequisites: Prerequisites: This course is designed for Intermediate to Advanced professionals. No prior actuarial qualification is required, but participants must have a working knowledge of basic statistics (mean, variance, probability) and financial concepts (liabilities, assets, capital). Familiarity with Excel is essential for hands-on exercises. Coding (Python/R) is not required, though exposure to data analytics tools is beneficial. This course focuses on operational application and conceptual awareness of advanced topics, not technical engineering or production-grade model deployment.
